leaf_blast.severity_guidance: High - Can cause severe yield loss.
nutrient_associations: High or excessive nitrogen application increases susceptibility to rice blast.
Adequate silicon and potassium improve resistance.

fertilizer_guidance.purpose: Avoid excess nitrogen to limit disease spread; apply potassium for improved disease resistance.

biological_management: Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens (20g/L) as a foliar spray.
chemical_management: Spray Tricyclazole (0.6g/L) or Propiconazole (1ml/L) if disease severity is high.
leaf_blast.irrigation_guidance: Avoid prolonged drought stress, which predisposes plants to neck blast.
prevention: Seed treatment with appropriate fungicides before sowing.

leaf_blotch.severity_guidance: Moderate - Usually occurs in later stages of crop growth.
nutrient_associations: Potassium deficiency can make leaves more susceptible to blotch and spots.

fertilizer_guidance.purpose: Correct potassium deficiency to strengthen leaf cell walls.

cultural_management: Remove heavily infected lower leaves to improve aeration.
biological_management: Foliar spray of neem seed kernel extract (NSKE) 5%.
chemical_management: Spray Mancozeb (2.5g/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L) during early symptom appearance.
leaf_blotch.irrigation_guidance: Maintain consistent water levels, avoid alternate extreme drying and flooding.
prevention: Use disease-free seeds and ensure proper field sanitation.

narrow_brown.severity_guidance: Low to Moderate - Typically affects mature plants.
nutrient_associations: Associated with potassium deficiency in soils.

fertilizer_guidance.purpose: Apply potassium to reduce severity of narrow brown leaf spot.

cultural_management: Use balanced fertilizers, especially correcting K deficiency.
Ensure proper planting density to allow air circulation.
biological_management: Pseudomonas fluorescens root dip or foliar application.
chemical_management: Fungicide application like Propiconazole is effective if applied at booting stage.
prevention: Avoid late planting and use early maturing varieties.

Segatoka infected.severity_guidance: High - Can severely impact fruit filling and yield.
nutrient_associations: Potassium is heavily required by bananas; deficiency weakens leaves.
Proper nitrogen-potassium ratio is critical for resistance.

fertilizer_guidance.purpose: Support rapid new leaf emergence and correct potassium deficit.

cultural_management: Prune and destroy severely infected lower leaves.
Maintain proper spacing (e.g., 2m x 2m for Nendran).
chemical_management: Spray Propiconazole (1ml/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L) + Mancozeb (2g/L) with a sticking agent.
Segatoka infected.irrigation_guidance: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation which spreads fungal spores.
prevention: Ensure proper field drainage during monsoons.
Segatoka infected.source: KAU Package of Practices for Banana

Canker Rubber Tree.severity_guidance: High - Can destroy the tapping panel.
nutrient_associations: Overall plant vigor requires balanced NPK. No direct cure, but healthy bark resists better.

fertilizer_guidance.purpose: Maintain optimal nutrition for bark regeneration.

cultural_management: Scrape off the affected bark tissues and burn them.
biological_management: Apply Trichoderma-enriched compost around the base.
chemical_management: Apply Mancozeb or Copper Oxychloride paste on the scraped panel.
Canker Rubber Tree.irrigation_guidance: Ensure excellent drainage; Phytophthora thrives in waterlogged conditions.
prevention: Avoid tapping during heavy rainy days when bark is wet.

Pink Disease.severity_guidance: High - Causes branch die-back and bark splitting.
nutrient_associations: None specifically documented, requires direct fungicide application.

fertilizer_guidance.purpose: Fertilizer does not cure this disease. Follow standard schedule.

chemical_management: Apply Bordeaux paste or Copper Oxychloride on affected forks/branches.
prevention: Prophylactic spraying of Bordeaux mixture (1%) before monsoons.

Brown BastTree Trunk.severity_guidance: Moderate - Causes dryness of tapping panel.
nutrient_associations: Often related to over-tapping or physiological stress rather than direct nutrient deficiency.

fertilizer_guidance.purpose: Provide balanced nutrition to support recovery from physiological stress.

cultural_management: Give the tree a tapping rest for 3 to 6 months.
chemical_management: Not applicable. Scrape dry bark to stimulate regeneration.
prevention: Follow recommended tapping systems (e.g., d/2 or d/3) and avoid excessive stimulant (Ethephon) usage.

bacterial.severity_guidance: High - Can spread rapidly under high humidity.
nutrient_associations: Excess nitrogen increases susceptibility to bacterial infections.
Adequate potassium improves cell wall strength against bacterial ingress.

fertilizer_guidance.purpose: Reduce nitrogen application immediately; ensure potassium is optimal.

cultural_management: Avoid overhead watering to minimize splash dispersal.
Remove and destroy infected plant parts.
Ensure proper plant spacing for aeration.
biological_management: Apply Bacillus subtilis or Pseudomonas fluorescens formulations.
chemical_management: Copper-based bactericides (e.g., Copper Oxychloride) or Streptocycline as per local recommendations.
bacterial.irrigation_guidance: Use drip irrigation instead of sprinklers.

brown_spot.severity_guidance: Moderate - Often indicates poor soil health or stress.
nutrient_associations: Heavily associated with deficient soils (low nitrogen, potassium, or micronutrients like silicon/zinc).

fertilizer_guidance.purpose: Address overall nutritional stress, specifically checking N and K levels.

chemical_management: Mancozeb or Zineb spray if severity warrants chemical control.
prevention: Maintain optimal soil fertility and organic matter.

rust.severity_guidance: Moderate to High - Rapid airborne spread.
nutrient_associations: High nitrogen combined with low potassium increases rust susceptibility.

fertilizer_guidance.purpose: Balance NPK ratio, focusing on adequate Potassium.

cultural_management: Adjust planting dates to avoid peak rust seasons if applicable.
chemical_management: Spray Propiconazole or Hexaconazole at early symptom appearance.
rust.irrigation_guidance: Avoid late afternoon/evening irrigation that leaves foliage wet overnight.
